## A movie from stills

![A traveling wave, 24 frames drawn by make_frames.py](movies/wave.mp4)

::: notes
`frames/wave/` holds the stills; Make.common's movie rule runs frames2movie.py into
`movies/wave.mp4` and its poster. HTML and pptx play it with the slide, looped and muted; the PDF
shows the poster with a play badge, a link to the movie.
:::
